title: Beyond Static Leaderboards: Capability-Focused Evaluation with Structural Diversity for Time Series Foundation Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.26251v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Static public benchmarks for time series foundation models (TSFMs) typically have fixed and narrow test distributions. Their repeated reuse encourages benchmark-specific tuning, making reported performance reflect adaptation to the fixed test set rather than genuine forecasting generalization. In addition, a single aggregate score cannot fully characterize model capabilities across distinct temporal structures and input relationships. We propose CaFE (Capability-Focused Evaluation), a refreshable evaluation extension grounded in original benchmark data that enriches static benchmarks with structural diversity and enriches single-score black-box evaluation with multi-dimensional, capability-oriented assessment. translated_title: 超越静态排行榜：面向时间序列基础模型的结构多样性能力评估
translated_abstract: 时间序列基础模型（TSFM）的静态公开基准通常具有固定且狭窄的测试分布。这些基准的反复使用会助长针对特定基准的调优，使得报告的性能反映的是对固定测试集的适应，而非真正的预测泛化能力。此外，单一的聚合分数无法全面刻画模型在不同时间结构和输入关系下的能力。我们提出了CaFE（能力聚焦评估），这是一个基于原始基准数据的可刷新评估扩展，它通过结构多样性丰富静态基准，并通过多维度的、面向能力的评估丰富单一分数的黑盒式评估。CaFE首先对原始基准进行特征分析，定义了八个刻画其时间结构的结构特征（SF）。对于每个结构特征，它根据其结构支持度对原始数据进行重采样，并去除边缘分布外……
tldr: 该论文提出CaFE评估框架，通过八个结构特征对原始基准数据进行重采样以引入结构多样性，将时间序列基础模型的评估从静态单一分数排行榜升级为可刷新的多维能力导向评估，从而更真实地反映模型的泛化能力。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes CaFE, a refreshable capability-focused evaluation framework that resamples original benchmark data across eight structural features to introduce structural diversity and multi-dimensional assessment, moving beyond static single-score leaderboards to more faithfully measure the generalization ability of time series foundation models.
